title: Pilbara Minerals
summary: Australian lithium producer operating the Pilgangoora hard-rock mine.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Pilbara Minerals mines and concentrates spodumene at Pilgangoora in Western Australia and is expanding into downstream refining with partners. Its product feeds Chinese and other converters that make battery-grade lithium chemicals. Price realisations and Chinese demand set the outcome.

Technology Exposure

  • Spodumene concentrate
  • Downstream lithium refining partnerships
  • Mine expansion projects

What To Watch

  • Spodumene pricing
  • Chinese conversion demand
  • Expansion capex

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
